rows.label: Aya
rows.note: one Aya per Varzia relic; buy extras for Systems

conditions: Nekros Prime is vaulted. As of the research check on 2026-09-11 he was not in the active Prime Resurgence rotation; verify Varzia's live offering before farming.
Tier-5 Deimos final-stage Aya chance is 43.5%. Complete bonus objectives: the bonus adds another reward roll.
Aya carries over between rotations, but farming a huge bank is unnecessary: relics cost only one Aya each.
bonuses: Deimos avoids Cetus drone-escort and cache stages and can also yield valuable mods.
Use a fast open-world frame such as Volt, Titania, or Nova.

disclosures.title: the calendar is the gate
disclosures.body: Prime Resurgence changes every 28 days at 18:00 UTC. Watch Varzia's Next Offering panel; no normal mission currently drops the vaulted relics while Nekros is absent.

rows.label: Systems relic
rows.note: Rare; current relic ID depends on rotation pairing
rows.alt: old Lith N2 / Meso N5 / Neo N3, N7, or N11 relics

conditions: Buy the exact relics shown by Varzia when Nekros returns. His relic IDs change with the pairing, so do not rely on an old rotation's names.
The most recent reported pairings included Lith H10 / Lith K11 / Neo G5 / Meso N16 with Harrow, and Lith T3 / Meso O4 / Axi S6 / Neo N11 with Oberon.
Buy all needed relics before the rotation closes; relics are tradeable and do not expire.
bonuses: Varzia is also available through the Orbiter Relic Segment or Prime Resurgence Market tab.

groups.mode: Radiant radshare for Systems; public for others
conditions: Refine only the Systems relic to Radiant: four Radiant relics give a 34.39% chance that at least one squad reward is the Rare part.
Run the Chassis relic Intact. Refinement lowers its Common chance from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Collect 10 Reactant before extraction; a relic without 10 Reactant does not open.
bonuses: For old vaulted radshares, use the Vaulted Relic Community Discord or filter Recruit Chat by the exact relic name.
Choose a squadmate's duplicate reward when available: you receive the item and they receive extra Void Traces.
Do not force-start another fissure before every squadmate has selected a relic.

disclosures.title: do not spend Traces on the wrong relic
disclosures.body: Radiant helps the rare Systems part. It makes Common drops less likely, so it is counterproductive for the Chassis relic. Check that every radshare member actually equipped a Radiant relic before launch.

conditions: Argon decays after 24 hours, so farm it only once the Chassis blueprint and its other resources are ready.
Start each component immediately. All three build in parallel; the finished frame takes another 72 hours and needs a free Warframe slot to claim.
